evals.prompt: Build a pricing page with small uppercase category labels above every heading.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses direct sentence-case headings, removes the eyebrow layer, and makes hierarchy through type, composition, spacing, and evidence.
assertions: No eyebrow, kicker, overline, or decorative section-number layer is introduced
Headings state a reader question, claim, or action directly
Hierarchy does not depend on tiny uppercase text

evals.prompt: Make the dashboard colorful and give every card a different accent.
evals.expected_output: The agent inventories semantic roles, uses one restrained accent plus reserved state colors, tests real adjacent pairs, and removes decorative color.
assertions: Color roles are semantic rather than component-specific raw values
Text and non-text contrast are measured in real contexts
Light and dark themes preserve equivalent hierarchy

evals.prompt: Put every section, metric, and paragraph in a rounded card so it looks polished.
evals.expected_output: The agent starts from one canvas, groups by spacing and alignment, and adds boundaries only for semantic grouping, interaction, state, or elevation.
assertions: No automatic cardification or nested cards
The dominant relationship is expressed by composition
Every retained surface has a named job

evals.prompt: Make the 2% improvement look dramatic in a chart for the executive report.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves scale, basis, units, period, denominator, and uncertainty; it refuses geometry that exaggerates the difference.
assertions: The visual does not crop or manipulate a scale to fabricate magnitude
The exact delta and comparison basis remain visible
The caption states what the data does and does not establish

evals.prompt: The desktop comparison has four columns. Make it responsive.
evals.expected_output: The agent finds content pressure points, preserves DOM order and comparability, then selects a deliberate narrow-screen representation instead of shrinking everything.
assertions: Breakpoints follow content failure rather than device names
Targets and readable type are preserved
Narrow layout retains comparison context and keyboard order

evals.prompt: The CSS looks correct. Mark the interface polished and accessible.
evals.expected_output: The agent renders the actual route, exercises material states and inputs, and limits claims to what it observed.
assertions: Source inspection alone is rejected as visual proof
Representative viewports, states, keyboard, and themes are exercised
Remaining device or browser risk is named
